title: Final Accounts Unit Bulletin: Carried Late Payment Charge on Electric Service Agreement Final Bills
content:
No late payment charge can be posted on a closed **Electric Service Agreement**. When the unpaid balance of a closed agreement is transferred, the transfer therefore carries the late payment charge of the final bill at a carried rate, set by the number of calendar days that have passed from the carried-charge anchor date to the transfer day.

## The carried rate

| Calendar days from the carried-charge anchor date to the transfer day | Carried rate |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | the schedule's late payment charge rate, in full |
| 40 to 59 | half (0.5) of the schedule's late payment charge rate |
| fewer than 40 | no carried rate |

The schedule is the closed agreement's schedule.

## Where the carried rate acts

The carried late payment charge is the carried rate multiplied by the final bill's unpaid portion, rounded to the cent. The final bill's unpaid portion is the smaller of the final bill's amount and the closed agreement's balance, never below zero. The carried late payment charge is added to the closed agreement's balance before the transfer amount is rounded to the cent.

## Boundary days (hypothetical)

- On the 60th day after the anchor date the full rate applies; on the 59th day half the rate applies.
- On the 40th day half the rate applies; on the 39th day no carried rate applies and nothing is carried.

## Figures (hypothetical inputs)

Hypothetical late payment charge rate of 2%, final bill's unpaid portion of USD 118.40:

- 72 days: 2% of 118.40 is 2.368, carried late payment charge USD 2.37.
- 45 days: 1% of 118.40 is 1.184, carried late payment charge USD 1.18.
- 21 days: no carried rate, carried late payment charge USD 0.00.
